items.summary: Ford Q3 total revenue $49.53 billion, down 1.9% year on year. CLS, Oct 29: Ford's Q3 total revenue was $49.53 billion, down 1.9% year on year; adjusted EPS was $0.49 against $0.45 a year earlier and a $0.41 estimate; adjusted EBIT was $2.7 billion, up 3.8% year on year against a $2.38 billion estimate.
